probes.name: the holo sticker page is up

posts.text:
The sticker in this reel is not an image. It is a holographic foil sticker drawn live in your browser, a Labs experiment in rendering a physical material on the spot: the die-cut outline, the iridescent foil, the light it reflects and the peeling corner are all computed as you watch, with no images and no model files.

Tilt it with your pointer the way you would tilt the real thing, or type your own text and it is cut into a sticker of its own. three.ws/holo

How the cut works: the mark is rasterized, dilated by a disc the way a cutter adds a margin, and traced back into vector outlines with marching squares, holes included. The foil is a physical material with thin-film iridescence, and the peel is a vertex-shader cylinder roll, so the light on the curled lip is real.

Four foils, up to 16 characters of your own text, and a PNG download of whatever you make.
